title: Actions related to transmission of ULDedicatedMessageSegment message

entities.name: UL Dedicated Message Segmentation Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for segmenting UL DCCH messages into ULDedicatedMessageSegment messages based on PDCP SDU size constraints and transmitting them in order.

entities.name: ULDedicatedMessageSegment
entities.description: RRC message segment containing a portion of a segmented UL DCCH message.

entities.name: segmentNumber
entities.description: Indicates the sequence number of the message segment, starting from 0 and incrementing for each subsequent segment.

entities.name: rrc-MessageSegmentContainer
entities.description: Contains the actual segment data of the UL DCCH message corresponding to the segmentNumber.

entities.name: rrc-MessageSegmentType
entities.description: Indicates whether the segment is the last segment (lastSegment) or not (notLastSegment) of the UL DCCH message.

entities.name: Last segment condition
entities.description: Condition that is true when the current segment is the last segment of the UL DCCH message.

entities.name: Minimize number of segments
entities.description: UE behavior requirement to minimize the number of segments when segmenting the UL DCCH message.

entities.name: Ascending order transmission
entities.description: Requirement to transmit ULDedicatedMessageSegment messages in ascending order based on segmentNumber.

relations.description: The segmentation procedure involves generating ULDedicatedMessageSegment messages.
The value of rrc-MessageSegmentType is determined by whether the segment is the last segment.
The procedure requires minimizing the number of segments.
The procedure requires transmitting segments in ascending order based on segmentNumber.
